title: Democratic Impact Monitor: National Anti Counterfeiting Product Integrity and Quality Standards Bill
objective: Track digital track-and-trace adoption, counterfeit seizure rates, and consumer compensation.

indicators.name: Digital Track-and-Trace Compliance Rate
indicators.definition: Proportion of consumer commodities carrying active QR/RFID track-and-trace serialization codes.

oversight.composition: Judges, customs officials, consumer advocates, technical experts

complaints.channel: National Counterfeit Product Reporting Portal & App

triggers.condition: Detection of counterfeit Life-Critical Commodities in commercial supply chains or e-commerce platforms.
triggers.detector: National Product Authenticity Portal & Consumer Reports
triggers.interim_protection: Mandatory digital takedown and inventory seizure order
triggers.correction: Seizure, forensic analysis, syndicate prosecution, asset forfeiture
triggers.public_notice: Public red alert notice on National Portal
